# PULSE

This project repository includes code to pull groundwater data for the [B.C. Provincial Groundwater Observation Well Network](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=B03D0994BB5C4F98B6F7D4FD8610C836) and launch a data dashboard (via shiny). Data is publicly available [here](https://www2.gov.bc.ca/gov/content?id=B03D0994BB5C4F98B6F7D4FD8610C836), however a **username and password is required to access data through the API and run the scripts below.**

### Usage

There are three core scripts that are required to retrieve the data from Aquarius and launch the HyPPO shiny app. The scripts need to be run in order:

- 01_field-visit.R
- 02_timeseries.R
- 03_telemetry.R
